House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Housing Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a statewide tenant education and hotline service.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; STATEWIDE TENANT EDUCATION AND HOTLINE SERVICE. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a statewide tenant education and hotline service that provides free and confidential legal advice for all Minnesota renters. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a statewide tenant education and hotline service.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; STATEWIDE TENANT EDUCATION AND HOTLINE SERVICE.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a statewide tenant education and hotline service that provides free and confidential legal advice for all Minnesota renters.
additions: APPROPRIATION; STATEWIDE TENANT EDUCATION AND HOTLINE SERVICE.
